title: QuickGuide
guidance: Find the QuickGuide on the EG1011 website. Review the key concepts, formulas, diagrams, and decision rules.

title: Selected lecture-note sections
guidance: Open the lecture notes on the EG1011 website. Study only the sections connected to the current outcomes and annotate one worked example.

title: Step by Step with Mehdi
guidance: Use the relevant Step by Step with Mehdi PDF. Pause at each decision and predict the next step before reading it.

title: Interactive exercise app
guidance: Open the matching interactive exercise from the subject website. Use feedback to identify misconceptions before independent practice.

title: T-type tutorial questions
guidance: Attempt the relevant T question and explain why each equation or method is appropriate. Use tutorial support where needed.

title: H-type independent questions
guidance: Attempt the relevant H question independently before checking any worked solution or video.

title: Exit check
guidance: Test whether you can select the method and complete the main steps without prompts. Target at least 4 out of 5.
